S05_SH020_task1_auto (fx_seen_ice glint on wooden grave crosses and coats)

MI-01_flame_in_open_grate.rule: Glowing coals and upper flame plume deform; dark iron grating bars crossing the fire and the lower basket legs are clamped to 0.0 geometric displacement.

MI-02_flame_on_candle_wick.rule: Only the luminous teardrop plume above the wick deforms geometrically; the wax body, tin holder rim, and crate below the wick apex receive 0.0 geometric warp and soft radial light spill only.

MI-03_steam_over_held_vessel.rule: Steam is rendered as a pure translucent screen-blended alpha wisp originating above the vessel's top rim and masked off the vessel body and fingers (zero pixel remap on the mug or hand).

MI-04_breath_from_mouth.rule: Cold breath puffs originate at the mouth anchor and drift outward as an alpha screen layer occluded by the face mask, never warping facial features.

MI-05_sky_and_ground_weather.rule: Sky effects (stars, cloud_drift, sun_glint) are multiplied by verified sky_mask * (1 - dilated_fg_mask), even when a target box is supplied. Ground frost glints are multiplied by snow_ground_mask * (1 - dilated_fg_mask) and suppressed completely on solemn burial/memorial shots.

MI-06_cloth_on_rigid_support.rule: The proximal 20% attachment band adjacent to the rigid pole or torso is pinned at 0.0 displacement with a smooth cubic ramp toward the free fabric edge.
